paras: The V2 front lip is a wider, more aggressive evolution of the original — more front overhang, a bolder silhouette, and the signature styling ADRO fans have been asking for.

The V2 lip is designed to work alongside the GR Supra Prepreg Front Bumper Canards . The V1 lip paired with ADRO's full front aero kit produced a 970% increase in downforce at a minimal drag penalty at 180 kph. The V2 lip and canards together are designed to push that further.
